title: Data-driven Prediction of Satellite-observed Avalanche Activity from Snowpack Simulations
abstract: arXiv:2609.15485v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Avalanche forecasting requires knowledge of snowpack conditions and recent avalanche activity, but field observations are sparse across large mountain regions. We explore whether SNOWPACK simulations can predict avalanche activity mapped by synthetic aperture radar (SAR). We compiled five winters of Sentinel-1 avalanche detections across Norway and parts of Sweden, alongside SNOWPACK simulations forced by numerical weather predictions on a 20 x 20 km grid at different elevations and predefined slope angles. A transformer used five days of SNOWPACK outputs to predict the following day's SAR-detected Avalanche Activity Index (SAR-AAI). This index weights larger debris more heavily, spreads detections across possible occurrence dates and normalises by modelled runout area. The model was trained on four winters and evaluated on one validation winter. Regional mean predicted and reference SAR-AAI correlated at r = 0.803 after averaging over c

translated_title: 基于雪层数值模拟的数据驱动卫星观测雪崩活动预测
translated_abstract: 雪崩预报需要了解雪层状况和近期雪崩活动，但在广阔的山区，野外观测十分稀少。我们探讨了SNOWPACK雪层模拟能否预测由合成孔径雷达（SAR）绘制的雪崩活动。我们汇编了挪威及瑞典部分地区五个冬季的Sentinel-1卫星雪崩探测数据，以及由数值天气预报驱动、在20×20公里网格上不同海拔高度和预设坡度角度进行的SNOWPACK模拟。一个transformer模型利用五天的SNOWPACK输出来预测第二天的SAR探测雪崩活动指数（SAR-AAI）。该指数对较大的雪崩堆积体赋予更高权重，将探测结果分布到可能的发生日期上，并按模拟的雪崩运程区域进行归一化。模型在四个冬季的数据上训练，并在一个验证冬季上评估。区域平均的预测值与参考SAR-AAI在平均后的相关系数达到r = 0.803。
tldr: 本研究提出利用transformer模型从SNOWPACK雪层数值模拟中预测卫星SAR探测的雪崩活动指数，在挪威五个冬季的数据上实现了r=0.803的高相关性，为观测稀疏的大范围山区雪崩预报提供了新的数据驱动方法。
en_tdlr: A transformer model predicts satellite SAR-detected avalanche activity from SNOWPACK snowpack simulations, achieving r=0.803 correlation across five winters of Nordic data, offering a new data-driven approach for avalanche forecasting in vast, observation-sparse mountain regions.
